description: Everything in the person's Foliopeak notification bell, in the same words: balances not updated in a while, gaps in their figures (a missing interest rate, birth year or price), goals behind, dates coming up and changes waiting for their approval. Each line says which fix, if any, can be proposed and what it needs. Use for 'sort out my notifications', 'what needs doing in Foliopeak', 'help me clear the bell'.
name: list_notifications
title: Notifications
